"import json, numpy as np
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc


def run(fn=None, t4=None):
    p = pyc.MPCycle()
    p.pct_fan_bypass = 0.0
    # Design point
    design = p.p.design
    # OPR 13.5 via compressor pressure ratio
    p.p.design.splitter.BPR = 0.0
    p.p.design.compressor.PR = 13.5

    # Set balances
    if fn is not None:
        p.p.design.balance.Fn_target = fn
    if t4 is not None:
        p.p.design.balance.T4_target = t4

    p.setup()
    p.set_solver_debug(False)
    p.run_model()
    return {
        'Fn': p.get_val('design.perf.TSFC')[0],
        'T4': p.get_val('design.comp.Tt')[0],
    }


# Instead of relying on uncertain internal names, we build the standard
